question: What are the top 5 items with the highest year-over-year growth percentage in total sales revenue for the year 2023?
sql:
-- Get top 5 items with highest YoY growth percentage
WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    SUM(sale_dollars) AS total_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
    AND bottles_sold > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
),
item_revenues AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2022,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023
  FROM yearly_sales
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  revenue_2022,
  revenue_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_2023 - revenue_2022, revenue_2022) * 100 AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM item_revenues
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
